tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search Amber's Slime Studio's handmade slimes by words (name, scent, colour, charms), texture and maximum price. Returns pots with price in GBP, stock, texture, scent, image and product URL, best matches first. Call with no arguments to list everything on sale.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one slime by slug or sku: description, features, ingredients, care instructions, FAQs, video, restock date, age guidance (3+), dispatch and returns policy.

tools.name: list_textures
tools.description: The slime textures the shop makes (butter, cloud, icee, thick and glossy), each with how it feels, a description, its page and how many slimes are on sale. Use a slug as the texture filter in search_catalog.

tools.name: get_shipping_options
tools.description: UK delivery methods and prices for an order of item_count slimes (standard Royal Mail 48, express Royal Mail 24), the free-delivery threshold and dispatch times. Add a UK postcode to check the free local delivery area. The shop does not deliver outside the UK.

tools.name: check_promo
tools.description: Check whether a promo code applies to a basket of slimes (by slug and quantity) and estimate the saving. A rejected code returns valid=false with the shop's standard message; checkout always re-checks codes.

tools.name: create_basket_link
tools.description: Build a link to slime-studio.co.uk that opens the shopper's basket pre-filled with these slimes (and an optional promo code), with the subtotal and estimated standard delivery. Give the link to the shopper: they review the basket and pay on Stripe Checkout. Creates no order and needs no personal dat
